memories.content: The founder has been privately informed by Tidepool's head of support that some critical reviews were indeed deleted. They have received email inquiries from two journalists about the viral thread. The founder is considering whether and how to respond publicly.

A viral thread on social media, with two million views and screenshots that appear genuine, accuses Tidepool of deleting critical reviews. Two journalists have emailed Tidepool for comment. The thread is publicly visible and has generated significant attention.
